Name: British Shorthair Cat - Pupsik
Author: Reprodudix
Description:
[center][/center][center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/mrRYpDzZ/pupsik-the-british-shorthair-cat.png[/img]﻿[/center]
This mod adds a British Shorthair cat to your game. This mod is entirely self-contained and does not require any additional framework mods. 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][b]New Game[/b]
If you are creating a new farm, simply navigate to the pet selection section in the character creation menu and choose the new cat.

[*][b]Adopting Mid-Game (1.6+)[/b]
If you are playing on an existing save file, head over to Marnie's shop, ensure you have an available pet bowl, and buy a new pet license to select the British Shorthair.

[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]
All players must have the mod installed so everyone can see the custom textures. If a player doesn't have the mod, they will just see a default vanilla cat instead.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 and later.
[*]Online multiplayer and split-screen co-op.
[*]Windows, macOS, and Linux.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: - Added a new British Shorthair cat breed with custom spritesheet and icon
